newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Armstrong active on buy recommendations.
newsitem.headline: Armstrong active on buy recommendations.

text.p: Shares of precision engineering specialist Armstrong Industrial Corp Ltd were actively traded on Tuesday after several broking houses put buy recommendations on the stock, dealers said.
At 0841 GMT, Armstrong was up Singapore $0.025 at S$0.505 on heavy volume of 5.4 million shares.
Among the broking houses that recommended a buy on Armstrong was Fraser Securities.
"We visited the company and we liked the fundamentals. We recommended a buy on good earnings prospects," said Violet Soh, research manager at Fraser told Reuters.
Gilbert Ong Peng Koon, managing director of Armstrong, told Reuters he was unaware of any specific reason why Armstrong shares saw a sudden spurt of interest on Tuesday.
"I was told that overseas funds are looking at smaller capitalised stocks. Perhaps, our company is among those stocks," Ong said.
